_meta.description: Historical analog episodes for macro stress scenario backtest. All returns COMPUTED from data/raw/monthly_prices.csv (FRED SP500/DGS10, CBOE, EIA, LBMA). Re-run build_episodes.py to reproduce.
_meta.units: decimal returns (0.05=+5%) except YIELD_10Y_CHG (bps), VIX_CHG (pts), HY/IG_SPREAD_CHG (bps)
_meta.alignment_rule: start_anchor: if start_day≤7 → prior month, else current month. end_anchor: if end_day≤7 → prior month, else current month.
